product: Crude oil. The Santa Ynez Unit is about 100% oil. The buyer is California refining demand, a state that imports over 60% of its oil per the DOJ argument cited in the 2026-08-19 order; first sales went to Chevron in March 2026 (August 2026 investor presentation).
demand: Volume. Growth is the restart ramp: Q2 2026 averaged about 21 MBbl/d net and exited at about 40,000 net bbl/d, a 149% entry-to-exit rise (2026-08-10). Price is Brent-linked, but netbacks are cut by widened differentials and sulfur quality deducts; mix shifts toward lower-sulfur Hondo crude.
pricing_power: Thin netbacks: 2H 2026E marketing and GP&T deduct $24-28/Bbl and LOE $17-21/net Boe versus FY2027E $9-12 (2026-08-10). Sulfur quality deducts, $18.5M demurrage, a 15% TLB coupon with mandatory amortization, and $65/$89.39 collars capping upside.
competition: Not found. The competing supply is imported foreign crude, not a Chinese product: California imports over 60% of its oil (2026-08-19 order). Chemical sweetening to lower SYU sulfur content is planned to be tested Q4 2026 with full implementation in 2027 (2026-08-10).
market_strategy: CEO Jim Flores, 2026-08-10: encouraged by the productivity of the wells at the SYU with their higher than expected production with minimal to no observable decline. Same release promised Platform Hondo online September 2026, all 77 Harmony and Heritage wells onstream in Q3 2026, and 2H26 capex cut 41% to $85M.
bull: Q2 2026 revenue $137.1M, first positive operating cash flow, net sales up 149% entry-to-exit to ~40,000 bbl/d; 2026-08-19 court order shifted SYPS oversight to PHMSA and denied California's bid to block restart.
bear: Downstream partners capped sales at 40,000 gross bbl/d from July 2026; $18.5M demurrage plus sulfur deducts; 2H26 netbacks $24-28/Bbl; 15% TLB coupon; 90d analyst target change -43%; Hondo restart unverified.
falsifier: Platform Hondo fails to come online by 2026-09-30, or Q3 2026 net sales fall below 40,000 Boe/d versus 2H 2026E guidance of 40,000-45,000.

web_true_now_not_modelled: Q2 2026 exit about 40,000 net bbl/d (2026-08-10); downstream partners capped sales at 40,000 gross bbl/d from July 2026; $18.5M demurrage and sulfur quality deducts; Platform Hondo restart pending September 2026; shares rose to 191.87M from 154.5M at 2026-06-30 after $3.08 equity and converts; $65 Brent floor hedges.
web_demand_product: Crude oil. The Santa Ynez Unit is about 100% oil. The buyer is California refining demand, a state that imports over 60% of its oil per the DOJ argument cited in the 2026-08-19 order; first sales went to Chevron in March 2026 (August 2026 investor presentation).
web_price_volume_mix: Volume. Growth is the restart ramp: Q2 2026 averaged about 21 MBbl/d net and exited at about 40,000 net bbl/d, a 149% entry-to-exit rise (2026-08-10). Price is Brent-linked, but netbacks are cut by widened differentials and sulfur quality deducts; mix shifts toward lower-sulfur Hondo crude.
web_bottleneck: Midstream and downstream throughput. From July 2026 downstream partners capped Sable at 40,000 gross bbl/d; refineries limited Pacific OCS throughput and charged sulfur deducts (2026-08-10). Los Angeles marine terminal access and the idle San Pablo Bay pipeline also constrain marketing.
web_who_benefits_next: California refiners such as Chevron replacing imported barrels; the DOE and PHMSA and the US military energy-security posture (2026-08-19 order); LA-area marine terminals; wireline and Perf-Add service providers; Crimson Utilities if the San Pablo Bay Pipeline restarts (2026-08-10).
web_who_loses: Foreign crude exporters, tanker and cargo sellers displaced from the California market, plus refiners losing import volumes (2026-08-19 order; 2026-08-10 PR). California agencies including OSFM, State Parks and the Coastal Commission lose pipeline oversight authority.
web_margin_collapse_risk: Thin netbacks: 2H 2026E marketing and GP&T deduct $24-28/Bbl and LOE $17-21/net Boe versus FY2027E $9-12 (2026-08-10). Sulfur quality deducts, $18.5M demurrage, a 15% TLB coupon with mandatory amortization, and $65/$89.39 collars capping upside.
web_low_cost_substitute: Not found. The competing supply is imported foreign crude, not a Chinese product: California imports over 60% of its oil (2026-08-19 order). Chemical sweetening to lower SYU sulfur content is planned to be tested Q4 2026 with full implementation in 2027 (2026-08-10).
web_ceo_promised: CEO Jim Flores, 2026-08-10: encouraged by the productivity of the wells at the SYU with their higher than expected production with minimal to no observable decline. Same release promised Platform Hondo online September 2026, all 77 Harmony and Heritage wells onstream in Q3 2026, and 2H26 capex cut 41% to $85M.
web_did_they_deliver: Yes on the ramp. Heritage restarted April 2026; Q2 2026 delivered $137.1M revenue, first positive operating cash flow and a 149% entry-to-exit sales rise (2026-08-10). The July 2026 refinancing and March 2026 first sales also landed (2026-07-02 8-K). The September 2026 Hondo restart is still unverified.
web_what_would_falsify: Platform Hondo fails to restart by 2026-09-30; or Q3 2026 net sales fall below 40,000 Boe/d versus 2H 2026E guidance of 40,000-45,000 (2026-08-10); or the 40,000 gross bbl/d downstream cap and sulfur deducts persist; or California and OSFM prevail on the DPA Order challenge.
